== Who I am ==

My name is Austin Rhodes, and I have been a member of the Ubuntu Kernel Team
since April 2025.

I graduated with my Master's in Computer Science from the University of Tennessee in 2024. During my time in college I had also worked in IT sysadmin and helpdesk roles.

=== My Ubuntu story ===

When I asked for my first laptop as a teenager, my dad (an IT guy himself) gave me his spare and showed me how to install Ubuntu on it. Since then, Ubuntu has been the staple choice for toying with computers in my life because it is free, open source, quick to install, and widely supported. When I went into university as a computer science major, my investment into Ubuntu paid off hugely, as I was well ahead of my peers in using and understanding Linux. There has never been a time in my life where I didn't have at least one Ubuntu machine set up as a sever, a programming environment, or just for every day use.

=== My involvement ===

I work in the Testing & Tooling squad of the kernel team, developing new features and addressing issues in our boot/regression testing infrastructure.
